title: HEADS-ED
formula:
The HEADS-ED Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H ome | Example: How does your family get along with each other? | Supportive | 0 |
| Conflicts | 1 | | |
| Chaotic/dysfunctional | 2 | | |
| E ducation, employment | Example: How is your school attendance? How are your grades? Are you working? | On track | 0 |
| Grades dropping or absenteeism | 1 | | |
| Failing/not attending | 2 | | |
| A ctivities & peers | Example: What are your relationships like with your friends? | No change | 0 |
| Reduction in activities/increased peer conflicts | 1 | | |
| Increasingly to fully withdrawn/significant peer conflicts | 2 | | |
| D rugs & alcohol | Example: How often are you using drugs or alcohol? | None or infrequent | 0 |
| Occasional | 1 | | |
| Frequent/daily | 2 | | |
| S uicidality | Example: Do you have any thoughts of wanting to kill yourself? | No thoughts | 0 |
| Ideation | 1 | | |
| Plan or gesture | 2 | | |
| E motions, behaviors, thought disturbance | Example: How have you been feeling lately? | Mildly anxious/sad/acting out | 0 |
| Moderately anxious/sad/acting out | 1 | | |
| Significantly distressed/unable to function/out of control/bizarre thoughts/significant change in functioning | 2 | | |
| D ischarge or current resources | Example: Do you have any help or are you waiting to receive help (counseling etc.)? | Ongoing/well connected | 0 |
| Some/not meeting needs | 1 | | |
| None/on waitlist/noncompliant | 2 | | |

where 0 = “No action needed”, 1 = “Needs action but not immediate/moderate functional impairment”, 2 = “Needs immediate action/severe functional impairment”

how_to_use.when: Utilisez-vous HEADS-ED et souhaitez-vous mettre à contribution votre expertise ? [Rejoignez](https://www.mdcalc.com/join-us) notre équipe de contributeurs !

next_steps.advice:
- Un score de 0 pour un item implique qu’aucune action n’est nécessaire pour cette catégorie d’item, 1 correspond à la recommandation d’une action non urgente et d’une éducation sur les ressources communautaires, et 2 indique qu’une action immédiate et une orientation sont nécessaires.
- Une orientation vers une évaluation spécialisée en santé mentale doit également être envisagée si le score total est ≥8 ou si l’item « Suicidalité » est coté à 2.

more_info: Une orientation vers une évaluation spécialisée en santé mentale doit être envisagée si le score total est ≥8 ou si l'item « Suicidality » est coté à 2.
